name: Dewey Beach
headline: Ocean beach, ten minutes from Rehoboth, open every day of the year.
detail: Dogs are legal all summer — just not in the middle of the day. Before 9:30am and after 5:30pm from Memorial Day weekend through the Sunday after Labor Day, all day the rest of the year. This is the nearest legal summer ocean beach to Rehoboth by a wide margin, and almost nothing published tells you it exists.
conditions: Town dog license required, visitors included
hazards: Hot sand between 10am and 4pm — if you would not walk it barefoot, neither should the dog
feeNote: No beach fee. The dog license is the cost — 3-day, 8-day and lifetime terms.

name: Non-guarded and surf-fishing beaches, Delaware State Parks
headline: The year-round exception hiding inside the statewide ban.
detail: Delaware prohibits dogs on lifeguarded swimming beaches from May 1 to September 30. It does not prohibit them on the rest of the sand. The non-guarded stretches and the drive-on surf-fishing beaches at Cape Henlopen, Delaware Seashore and Fenwick Island State Park are open to leashed dogs all year, including July. This single distinction is the answer to the most-asked unanswered question on this coast.
conditions: Off the guarded swimming beaches between May 1 and September 30
Proof of rabies vaccination is required in state parks
Beach Plum Island is closed to pets year-round
Shorebird nesting areas and surfboarding beaches are closed to pets
hazards: Discarded fishhooks and cut monofilament line — this is the tradeoff. The beaches where a dog is legal in summer are the beaches people fish from.
Saltwater ingestion from dogs chasing balls into surf
feeNote: Park entry applies March 1 – November 30. From 2026 the beach parks are $10 for a Delaware-registered vehicle and $20 out-of-state. Annual passes are $50 and $100.

sources.note: Lifeguarded beaches closed to pets May 1 – September 30; non-guarded open year-round.

name: Slaughter Beach
headline: Bay beach, dogs every day of the year, and almost nobody there.
detail: Leashed dogs are welcome year-round. It is a quiet Delaware Bay beach about forty minutes north of Rehoboth, and it appears in most aggregator lists as one bullet among twelve, if at all. Calm shallow water rather than surf, which suits an older or nervous dog better than the ocean does.
hazards: Horseshoe crabs. This is a designated sanctuary and in May and June the beach is carpeted with spawning crabs and their molts. Dogs eat the molts. Disturbing spawning crabs or the shorebirds feeding on their eggs is also a genuine conservation problem.

sources.label: Town of Slaughter Beach
sources.note: Confirm the leash length and dune rule with the town.

name: Assateague Island National Seashore
headline: Ocean beach, dogs year-round — but only the National Seashore.
detail: Pets are welcome year-round in most of the Maryland portion of the National Seashore, including the beaches and the water, on a leash no longer than six feet. The catch is the name: Assateague State Park sits immediately alongside it and bans dogs entirely, as does the whole Virginia portion. People get this wrong constantly, and the two entrances are minutes apart.
conditions: Leash no longer than 6 feet at all times
Maryland portion only — pets are banned in the Virginia portion entirely
The National Seashore, NOT Assateague State Park next door
Off the lifeguard-protected beach in season
Not on nature trails, in backcountry campsites, or north to the Ocean City Inlet
Never left unattended, including in a vehicle
hazards: Wild horses. They bite and kick, they are genuinely wild, and a dog will provoke one.
feeNote: National Seashore entrance fee applies. Confirm the current rate with the park.

name: Lewes Beach
headline: Bay beach with an early-morning and evening window.
detail: Leashed dogs before 8am and after 6:30pm from May 1 to September 30. Calm bay water, walkable from town. Treat this one as provisional: a city committee met in December 2025 to consider banning dogs outright at the guarded beaches in summer, and we have found no record of the outcome.
conditions: Only outside the posted hours in season
hazards: Rule may have changed — confirm with the city before making the trip
feeNote: Beach parking fees apply in season.
